test_title: SSC CGL 2021 Tier-I (Held On : 19 April 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.**

A style of cooking food, characteristic of a particular country or region
solution: The correct answer is '**Cuisine**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate word for the given group of words is '**Cuisine**'. • It means 'the style of cooking of a particular country, restaurant, etc.'. (किसी विशेष देश, रेस्‍तराँ आदि की भोजन बनाने की शैली; पाक शैली) • *Example: Italian **cuisine**...* **Correct Answer:__** *Cuisine.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let's look at the meaning of other words: • **Creche**: a place where small children are looked after while their parents are working, shopping, etc. (माता-पिता की अनुपस्थिति में शिशुओं की देखभाल का स्‍थान; शिशुसदन, शिशुगृह) • **Antique**: very old and therefore unusual and valuable. (प्राचीनकाल की और अतएव असाधारण तथा मूल्‍यवान) • **Menu**: a list of the food that you can choose at a restaurant. [रेस्‍तराँ में उपलब्‍ध पदार्थों की सूची (अभीष्‍ट चुनने के लिए)] 17b:T4fa, The correct answer is **'To do something dangerous'.**
